name: SHAZ Sovereign APAC AI Neocloud Valuation
rationale: SharonAI Holdings Inc. (SHAZ) is scaling a 72MW NVIDIA GB300 AI factory in Australia with 19.9% strategic backing from Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness LP. At $50.01, our 5-year DCF yields a fair value of $143.02 (+186.0% upside at 11.66% WACC). Reverse DCF indicates the market is pricing in just 32.4% CAGR, well below our 55.0% base case. Recommendation: ACCUMULATE (Core Holding: 12.0 shares, 1.63% target weight). Accumulate on pullbacks near $44.02, trim Tier 1 at $110.00+.

bear.rationale: Execution delays in Australian 72MW datacenter construction; warrant dilution and power grid interconnect queues restrict Year 5 revenue to $405M with 12% margin.
risks: Delays in Australian power grid energization and high-density liquid cooling installation
Warrant exercise dilution from private placement financing rounds

base.rationale: 72MW NVIDIA GB300 AI factory energizes cleanly; 40,000 GPU cluster scales APAC sovereign and enterprise AI revenue to $1.19B at 22% net margin.
risks: Customer concentration across early enterprise AI foundation model labs
Global Neocloud competition from CoreWeave and Nebius entering APAC

bull.rationale: SharonAI becomes the premier APAC sovereign AI Neocloud backed by Situational Awareness LP (Aschenbrenner 20%); multi-hundred MW expansion achieves $2.51B revenue.
risks: Geopolitical trade restrictions on high-end NVIDIA accelerator exports
Rapid power utility tariff adjustments in Australian regional energy markets
